comparison_with_existing_instructions.existing_material_claim_citation_rule: Use source evidence and cite file paths with line numbers for material claims.
comparison_with_existing_instructions.existing_uncertainty_rule: If the available source cannot establish a claim, state the uncertainty.
comparison_with_existing_instructions.existing_budget_rule: Once the requested explanation is supported, stop investigating and give your final answer; at the budget boundary answer from available evidence and mark unverified points.
comparison_with_existing_instructions.why_rephrasing_is_insufficient: Both failures survived the current evidence/uncertainty instruction. The record alone does not show that stronger synonyms or another general reminder will change behavior.
comparison_with_existing_instructions.narrow_new_mechanism: An explicit final comparison of draft claims against already-returned code and against each other, before submission. No extra retrieval pass, tool, model invocation or longer budget. Evaluate only the resulting answer, not unverifiable assertions that an internal self-check occurred.
comparison_with_existing_instructions.testable_observation: Under the unchanged source-grounded rubric, does the final answer retain correct required facts/citations without unsupported added qualifications or intermediate-as-final conclusions? Independently list unsupported claims with evidence; do not turn this diagnostic list into a new scoring rule or choose only one favorable resource metric.

proposed_minimal_shared_instruction: Before submitting, check the draft against the evidence already retrieved: each definite claim must follow from the cited conditions, and later statements must not contradict those conditions. Remove unsupported optional detail; qualify unsupported required conclusions instead of guessing.

instruction_constraints.only_changed_factor: The generic shared final-verification instruction, under a new named protocol; retain original completion-v2 phases unchanged.
instruction_constraints.current_main: Recheck upstream main before any new run; do not change native Rust/MCP behavior while labeling it current-main. If main changed, version the new experiment and disclose it is no longer a single-factor same-runtime comparison.

bounded_execution_if_root_chooses_to_tes.frozen_before_calls: New instruction, run plan, primary and secondary interpretation, exact runtime identity and failure stopping rule; fresh judge blinded to arm/resources/history.
bounded_execution_if_root_chooses_to_tes.success_interpretation: Keep source_grounded_success primary. A new factual-point or wall improvement with both answers failing remains failure/mixed evidence. If both pass, quality is tied; input/resource improvement still uses the previously declared efficiency conditions. No metric switching.
bounded_execution_if_root_chooses_to_tes.causal_limit: One pair under new instructions cannot isolate the instruction effect from model/service variation against an old pair. It is a development feasibility observation, not a causal proof or held-out suite result.
bounded_execution_if_root_chooses_to_tes.stop_rule: If zg still fails the fixed source-grounded gate, or only optional-error counts/factual points/wall improve without a fixed primary-quality or existing-rule efficiency signal, stop this q004 instruction branch. Do not iterate more wording, select the best repeat, delete old failures, or expand to easier tasks based on the outcome.
bounded_execution_if_root_chooses_to_tes.no_run_alternative: If independent review judges the proposed final-pass instruction materially equivalent to the current evidence/uncertainty rules, do not run a new pair. Retain the cross-case diagnosis as a model/agent reliability limitation; do not manufacture another iteration.
